title: A Sigil for the Spire Again
author: Oscar Eriksen
blurb: Rafael Villalobos, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
